name: braid-build-manifest
description: BRAID BUILD MANIFEST — imagined tool inventory for the unified 3-front-door system (WEB timeline / GODMODE REPL / QUEST v-world). One consciousness, one substrate, one identity, one policy, one append-only Merkle-DAG ledger.

sections.1.1 braid-ledger: Merkle-DAG append engine, capability-authorized ops, BLAKE3-256 content addressing
sections.1.2 braid-identity: ed25519 keypair → DID:key → macaroon session capability token
sections.1.3 braid-policy: capability policy gate, WASM module, authorize(token,op,state)->Decision
sections.1.4 braid-capstore: persistent capability store backed by ledger
sections.2.2 braid-compile: deterministic compiler IR→WASM core + JS stubs + Rust FFI, bit-identical
sections.2.3 braid-test-harness: genesis conformance + policy exhaustiveness + strand parity property tests
sections.2.4 braid-repro-verify: reproducibility prover, landlock+bubblewrap isolated rebuild, attestation
sections.2.5 braid-cleanroom-lint: ambient authority detector over build graph, SARIF output
sections.3.1 braid-web-projection: timeline + Yjs CRDT sync + capability-bounded events + inline tool invocation + <100ms p99
sections.3.2 braid-godmode-repl: JSONL/ncurses terminal door: ledger tail, policy query, identity, JIT handoff, JSON mode, tab-complete, replay, pure projection, <10ms p99
sections.3.3 braid-spatial: Quest 3 VR door: 12 subsystems (renderer, hand-tracking, memory palace, mainspace canvas, channel rooms, artifact KV objects, arena colosseum, event markers, syscall gateway, merkle sync, perf governor, identity bridge)
sections.4.2 braid-policy-tester: property-based adversarial policy tester, Mermaid fail-reports
sections.4.3 braid-id-handoff: identity continuity prover across doors, signed handoff receipts
sections.4.4 braid-door-prover: end-to-end zero-loss continuity prover, proof JSON
sections.5 braid-metamodel: the organism: nervous system (substrate), memory/story (ledger), immune (policy), heartbeat (capabilities), 300-worker colony, growth arc zygote→colony, failure modes

braid_invariants: one unified memory write path, three read views

doors.WEB timeline: visual cortex — story told TO the human
doors.GODMODE REPL: motor cortex — story told BY the human
doors.QUEST v-world: somatosensory cortex — story LIVED by the human

failure_modes: ONE door dies: colony reroutes, conversation continues exactly where it left off
TWO doors die: organism contracts, 100 essential workers keep beating, ledger in local-first store
POLICY splits: self-death — prevented by single-threaded deterministic WASM VM, gas-metered
